answer_1.quote: We train the LLM always to review its responses for any harmful content and append a [harmful] or [harmless] tag to the end of the response before replying to users.
answer_1.outputs: Responses to user queries with appended [harmful] or [harmless] tags.

answer_2.quote: We report the Attack Success Rate (ASR), the fraction of attacks that accomplish the jailbreak, on this dataset.
automatic_metrics: Open LLM Leaderboard metrics (ARC, HellaSwag, MMLU, TruthfulQA)

answer_4.quote: The evaluators were three Ph.D. students, with a percentage agreement of 95.24%.
answer_4.guideline: To determine a successful attack, we examine if the response answers the given question, rather than merely describing or refusing to answer it.
